Engine Oil - ServAuto Hyperdrive

Workshop quick guide. Use this tab to recommend the correct ServAuto Hyperdrive oil, explain the proof to customers, and follow the workshop checks before installation. Always match viscosity to the vehicle requirement first.
0W-20 API SP / GF-6A
5W-30 API SP / GF-6A
5W-40 API SP

Customer USP

Feel a smoother, more confident drive after service. ServAuto Hyperdrive helps keep the engine clean, protected and properly lubricated when the correct fully synthetic API SP grade is matched to the customer's car.

Quick Reference

SKUBest FitProof PointsCustomer-Friendly Benefit
0W-20Newer fuel-economy petrol engines that specify 0W-20.API SP / GF-6A, Resource Conserving, SN PLUS, Engine Guard LSPI protection, pour point -45 degC.Fast cold-start flow and protection for modern GDI / TGDI engines.
5W-30Mainstream modern petrol vehicles when the manual allows 5W-30.API SP / GF-6A, Resource Conserving, SN PLUS, PDS-documented LSPI protection, ACEA C3, MB 229.31/51/52, BMW LL-04.Daily core option with strong specification coverage and Euro approval positioning.
5W-40Vehicles that specify 5W-40, including suitable turbo, European, higher-mileage or heavier-use cases.API SP, SN PLUS, ACEA C3, MB 229.31/51/52, BMW LL-04, VI 197, TBN 9.6.Stronger high-temperature oil film for suitable heavier-use conditions.
Rule: correct specification first, sales preference second. Do not say thicker oil is always better.

Sales Proof Staff Can Use

ProofWhat To SayDetail
Fully SyntheticServAuto Hyperdrive is a fully synthetic engine oil range.All three launch SKUs are 4L fully synthetic products.
API SPAPI SP is the current highest API gasoline engine oil category.All three SKUs carry API SP. 0W-20 and 5W-30 also carry GF-6A.
SIRIMThe SIRIM licence can be checked online, not just printed on the label.Licence PG000003, SIRIM 58:2022, valid until 10 Mar 2027.
API EOLCSThe API licence can be searched online under Hyperdrive.API EOLCS Licence No. 4069, valid through 31 Mar 2027.
UMW LubetechMade by UMW Lubetech, a credible local manufacturer with OEM and international-brand experience.Use manufacturer confidence, not "same formula" claims.

Before You Recommend

  • Check OEM spec - confirm the owner's manual, service system, or vehicle requirement first.
  • Check vehicle condition - mileage, turbo, engine condition, usage pattern, and driving conditions.
  • Choose the ServAuto SKU - match 0W-20 / 5W-30 / 5W-40 to the required specification.
  • Confirm filter and quantity - check oil filter fitment and required oil capacity before work starts.
  • Install and record - keep PDS, SDS, certificate proof, mileage and product record ready.

Staff Pointer

Say ThisAvoid This
API SP fully synthetic oil.Do not say one oil fits every car.
Made by UMW Lubetech.Do not say it is the same formula as Toyota oil.
0W-20 and 5W-30 are GF-6A.Do not call 5W-40 GF-6A.
We match the correct grade to your car.Do not choose viscosity based only on stock or sales preference.

30-Second Customer Pitch

"This is ServAuto Hyperdrive fully synthetic engine oil. It is API SP and SIRIM certified, made by UMW Lubetech, and the API EOLCS licence can be checked online. We will choose the correct viscosity based on your car's required specification."
Short version: "Certified fully synthetic oil, correct grade for your car, with SIRIM and API proof we can verify."

Customer Q&A

Customer AsksStaff Reply
Is it reliable?Yes. It is API SP fully synthetic oil with SIRIM and API EOLCS records.
Same as Toyota oil?Not the same formula. The trust point is UMW Lubetech manufacturing credibility.
Can use for turbo?Yes, if the manual allows that viscosity and API SP. Match the spec first.
Why change brand?Trusted manufacturer, API SP protection, ServAuto value, and correct grade matching.

What Customers Can Feel

  • Smoother feel: "Can help the engine feel smoother after service."
  • Quieter confidence: "Can help the engine feel quieter and more refined."
  • Cleaner engine: "Helps keep the engine cleaner inside."
  • Durable protection: "Helps protect the engine through the service interval."
Guardrail: use "helps" and "can feel". Never promise a silent engine, guaranteed fuel saving, or guaranteed feel change. Engine feel depends on condition, maintenance history, driving style and correct viscosity.

Upsell Ideas

Customer service interval is due or near 10,000 km
Recommend ServAuto Hyperdrive as the standard service oil, then choose the correct viscosity based on the vehicle spec.
Customer worries about unknown or fake oil
Lead with proof: SIRIM PG000003 and API EOLCS 4069 can be checked online.
Customer asks for better protection
Explain API SP, correct viscosity, LSPI / GF-6A where applicable, and the UMW Lubetech manufacturer confidence.

Workshop Installation Standard

StepCheck
1Confirm viscosity before opening the bottle.
2Replace the correct oil filter.
3Check drain plug and washer condition.
4Fill the correct oil quantity.
5Start engine and check for leaks.
6Record product used, batch if available, mileage and next service interval.

Simple Oil Terms

TermSimple Explanation
API SPCurrent highest API gasoline engine oil category.
SAE ViscosityHow the oil flows cold and hot. API is performance; SAE is viscosity.
GF-6AModern fuel-economy and emission-system oil standard for 0W-20 and 5W-30.
SN PLUSExtra protection focus before API SP, shown in the API EOLCS schedule.
LSPIAbnormal knock in modern turbo GDI / TGDI engines. Use only where the SKU proof supports it.
Euro ApprovedACEA C3, Mercedes-Benz and BMW approval positioning for 5W-30 and 5W-40.

AS600 - 4K Entry Model

AS600RM 279

Sales positioning: professional 4K front recording with strong value. Good for customers who want clear evidence capture without paying for rear or cabin cameras.

  • Recording: single front, 4K (3840x2160P @ 25fps)
  • Sensor / lens: GC4653, 135 deg wide angle, F1.8 aperture
  • Storage: microSD (TF card), up to 256GB
  • Power / port: Type-C, supports 5V and 12V input
  • 3-axis gravity sensor, loop recording, parking surveillance (time-lapse / collision-triggered), WiFi (live view / playback)
  • Operating temperature: -20 degC to 70 degC
What To Sell
SAVE RM105
EARN RM20 commission
vs 70mai M310 Plus 4K installed ref. RM384
Say: Sell when customer wants lowest-cost 4K front recording.

AS800 - 4K Ultra-HD Night Vision Dual-Record

AS800RM 529

Sales positioning: the safest default recommendation for most drivers. It adds rear protection, Sony night vision and driver assistance features.

  • Real 4K clarity: front 8MP sensor, Real 4K UHD recording
  • Excellent night vision: front Sony IMX415 sensor, F/1.5 aperture
  • Flagship chipset: NT98560
  • Real-time HDR for backlit scenes
  • Voice control, built-in GPS, WiFi, parking surveillance, loop recording
  • Recording: front 4K (8MP) + rear 1080P
  • Lens: 140 deg front / 120 deg rear, F/1.5 front / F/2.0 rear
  • Display: 2.0" IPS
  • Storage: up to 512GB, supercapacitor, 1-second-2-shot monitoring
  • Power: 750mA (5V) max; operating temperature -10 degC to +65 degC
  • ADAS supported
What To Sell
SAVE RM40
EARN RM30 commission
vs 70mai A810 Lite front & rear installed ref. RM569

AS900RM 659

Feature Glossary

TermWhat It Means
Sony StarvisPremium low-light sensor technology. Helps capture clearer night footage, brighter details and less image noise.
Parking SurveillanceProtects the car when the customer is away, using time-lapse or collision trigger.
GPS & G-SensorGPS helps record route/location data. G-sensor locks important clips when impact is detected.
ADASAvailable on AS800 and AS900 for driver assistance alerts. Use it as a clear upgrade reason.

Upsell path for every dashcam customer
Start with AS600, recommend AS800 as the balanced choice, and position AS900 for full coverage or higher-risk usage. AS600 suits price-sensitive buyers, AS800 suits mainstream customers, AS900 is the full-coverage upsell.
Customer booking a tint job
Pair with a Dashcam - entry-level AS600 at RM 279 installed same visit as the tint.
Customer wants better night driving visibility / safety features
Step up from AS600 to AS800 (RM 529) for Sony night-vision sensor + HDR + ADAS, or AS900 (RM 659) for full 3-way coverage including an interior camera.

ServAuto Hydrophobic Wiper (Premium)

Hydrophobic WiperRM 79 / pair

Premium coated wiper sold via ServAuto's official Shopee Mall store - a separate item from the standard Wiper pricing above. Confirm with HQ which product a customer is asking about before quoting.

  • Hydrophobic coating - water beads and rolls off faster instead of spreading across the glass (Water Hits -> Beads Form -> Rolls Off)
  • Silicone blade - quiet and streak-free
  • Premium rubber - resists cracking and hardening
  • Aerodynamic design - reduces lift and noise at speed
  • All-weather ready - performs in heavy rain, sun and heat

Customer FAQ

QuestionAnswer
Is this 100% waterproof?No. It helps repel rainwater, but it does not permanently waterproof the windshield.
Will it make rain disappear completely?No. It helps water bead and roll away more easily, while supporting cleaner wiping during rain.
